name: Selloff-range midpoint acceptance
hypothesis: Within 48 bars of a 96-bar low, buy when the last 4 bars' lows all held above the 96-bar range midpoint; stop 0.5 ATR under the midpoint; target the 96-bar high.

entry.long: since(low <= lowest(low,96)) <= 48 and persist(low > (highest(high,96)+lowest(low,96))/2, 4) and not persist(low > (highest(high,96)+lowest(low,96))/2, 5)
